notes: Nitrogen-starved samples (grown in N-deficient Gutnick medium) get treatment nitrogen_starvation (adapted); peptide-treated ones other_chemical;nitrogen_starvation (80 min -> short). Only the nitrogen-rich untreated samples are controls; the DMSO vehicle samples are the comparison baseline for the peptides but are themselves nitrogen-starved, so is_control false (debatable). growth_phase: OD 0.5 minimal + harvest 80 min later -> mid_exponential for nitrogen-rich only; left out for starved cells (likely not growing). Peptide concentration given as 10 mM in fields vs 10 µM in protocol. Carbon source not stated.
